additional_info.subject: ISO status not valid
additional_info.body:
IMD changing to not ready, after the second vehicle is plugged in.
See line 740 of the logs attached.
Need to understand, what is responsible for setting Status Code from Isolation_Monitoring_Active → Not Ready.
This appears only when the second vehicle is plugged in. It only stated happening when a new type of vehicle (Bus) was attached. The older variant, allowed for 2 vehicles to charge.
Swapping which bus connects to which dispenser first, does not seem to affect the operation, any order still fails.

additional_info.subject: 0425426 - ID0384544-DC/Si-D/AU-[MP / P6 170000724] Not charging two buses at one time [C1] CRM:00312000073
additional_info.body:
Hello Sambath,
Hope you are doing well. for case 0425426.
Would you be able to explain this? You mentioned that Error 20 might be to do with comms lost and that the Bender resets when it sends its warning level?
I'm not sure I understand this, why does the bender reset when it sends the warning? I have not seen this before, if the warning signal comes on then the bender usually remains active.
The charging session is ending, because the bender state is being change to "Not valid" what causes this to occur? The outlet is normally working fine, those I dont believe its the bender or wiring. It only becomes an issue when the second vehicle is connected.
Is there some logic in the charger that wont allow it from starting another charging session, if another connector is already in the "warning level"?
With Kind Regards,
Ferdinand Reisch
Siemens Ltd.
Application Service Engineer
Email: ferdinand.reisch@siemens.com
www.siemens.com.au/emobility
